answer: Forge-Anchor Challenge Chain: each new agent identity must solve a fresh challenge whose seed is the previous identity's signed output, then publish the full solution. The seed reaches a nadir of entropy at unpredictable intervals, forcing each identity to do irreducible sequential work tied to its predecessor. An attacker cannot reuse solutions across identities because each challenge depends on a unique onyx chain position. Per-identity cost is the full computation plus one unrepeatable signed artifact, making mass identity creation linear in real compute.
